--- create_model_struct_sized_fields.sql
CREATE MODEL m
INPUT (x STRUCT<a STRING(MAX), b BYTES(MAX), c STRING(10)>)
OUTPUT (y STRUCT<d BYTES(8)>)
REMOTE

--- AST
&ast.CreateModel{
  Remote: 105,
  Name:   &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 13,
    NameEnd: 14,
    Name:    "m",
  },
  InputOutput: &ast.CreateModelInputOutput{
    Input:        15,
    Rparen:       103,
    InputColumns: []*ast.CreateModelColumn{
      &ast.CreateModelColumn{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 22,
          NameEnd: 23,
          Name:    "x",
        },
        DataType: &ast.StructType{
          Struct: 24,
          Gt:     72,
          Fields: []*ast.StructField{
            &ast.StructField{
              Ident: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 31,
                NameEnd: 32,
                Name:    "a",
              },
              Type: &ast.SizedSchemaType{
                NamePos: 33,
                Rparen:  43,
                Name:    "STRING",
                Max:     true,
              },
            },
            &ast.StructField{
              Ident: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 46,
                NameEnd: 47,
                Name:    "b",
              },
              Type: &ast.SizedSchemaType{
                NamePos: 48,
                Rparen:  57,
                Name:    "BYTES",
                Max:     true,
              },
            },
            &ast.StructField{
              Ident: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 60,
                NameEnd: 61,
                Name:    "c",
              },
              Type: &ast.SizedSchemaType{
                NamePos: 62,
                Rparen:  71,
                Name:    "STRING",
                Size:    &ast.IntLiteral{
                  ValuePos: 69,
                  ValueEnd: 71,
                  Base:     10,
                  Value:    "10",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
    OutputColumns: []*ast.CreateModelColumn{
      &ast.CreateModelColumn{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 83,
          NameEnd: 84,
          Name:    "y",
        },
        DataType: &ast.StructType{
          Struct: 85,
          Gt:     102,
          Fields: []*ast.StructField{
            &ast.StructField{
              Ident: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 92,
                NameEnd: 93,
                Name:    "d",
              },
              Type: &ast.SizedSchemaType{
                NamePos: 94,
                Rparen:  101,
                Name:    "BYTES",
                Size:    &ast.IntLiteral{
                  ValuePos: 100,
                  ValueEnd: 101,
                  Base:     10,
                  Value:    "8",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE MODEL m INPUT (x STRUCT<a STRING(MAX), b BYTES(MAX), c STRING(10)>) OUTPUT (y STRUCT<d BYTES(8)>) REMOTE
